ESP32-E22.name: ESP32-E22
ESP32-E22.family_notes: Radio Co-Processor (RCP) architecture — not a standalone MCU. Fields like gpio_count/adc_channels/pwm reflect the RCP's own die, not a system built around it; a host processor is always required. No standalone series datasheet PDF was publicly indexed at last check (2026-08-16) — facts below are sourced from Espressif's product page and press announcement, not a datasheet. Treat with the same "status: no_public_pdf" caution as the source registry entries.

ESP32-S31.name: ESP32-S31
ESP32-S31.family_notes: Entered mass production 2026-07-27 per Espressif's press announcement. No standalone series datasheet PDF was publicly indexed at last check (2026-08-16); facts below are sourced from the product page and mass- production announcement. deep_sleep_ua is intentionally null — this is the PoC's worked example of "we do not know yet" being a first-class, explicit machine-readable state rather than a silently omitted table cell or a guessed number.
